answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the atlas of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the vine of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the lagoon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
